title: あいさつ — Greetings
summary: A simple morning exchange between two friends.

paragraphs.text: 朝、田中さんと佐藤さんは学校で会います。
paragraphs.romanization: Asa, Tanaka-san to Satou-san wa gakkou de aimasu.
paragraphs.translation: In the morning, Tanaka and Sato meet at school.
paragraphs.translation_en: In the morning, Tanaka and Sato meet at school.
paragraphs.translation_id: Di pagi hari, Tanaka dan Sato bertemu di sekolah.

paragraphs.text: 田中さんは「おはようございます」と言います。
paragraphs.romanization: Tanaka-san wa 'ohayou gozaimasu' to iimasu.
paragraphs.translation: Tanaka says 'good morning'.
paragraphs.translation_en: Tanaka says 'good morning'.

paragraphs.text: 佐藤さんも「おはようございます」と言います。
paragraphs.romanization: Satou-san mo 'ohayou gozaimasu' to iimasu.
paragraphs.translation: Sato also says 'good morning'.
paragraphs.translation_en: Sato also says 'good morning'.

summary_en: A simple morning exchange between two friends.
summary_id: Pertukaran pagi sederhana antara dua teman.

title: じこしょうかい — Self-Introduction
summary: Introducing yourself to a new classmate.

paragraphs.text: はじめまして。私は鈴木です。
paragraphs.romanization: Hajimemashite. Watashi wa Suzuki desu.
paragraphs.translation: Nice to meet you. I am Suzuki.
paragraphs.translation_en: Nice to meet you. I am Suzuki.

paragraphs.text: 私は東京から来ました。
paragraphs.romanization: Watashi wa Toukyou kara kimashita.
paragraphs.translation: I came from Tokyo.
paragraphs.translation_en: I came from Tokyo.

paragraphs.text: 私は学生です。どうぞよろしくお願いします。
paragraphs.romanization: Watashi wa gakusei desu. Douzo yoroshiku onegaishimasu.
paragraphs.translation: I am a student. Nice to meet you.
paragraphs.translation_en: I am a student. Nice to meet you.

summary_en: Introducing yourself to a new classmate.
summary_id: Memperkenalkan diri kepada teman sekelas baru.

title: わたしの一日 — My Day
summary: A student describes an ordinary day.

paragraphs.text: 私は毎朝六時に起きます。
paragraphs.romanization: Watashi wa maiasa roku-ji ni okimasu.
paragraphs.translation: I wake up at six every morning.
paragraphs.translation_en: I wake up at six every morning.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya bangun jam enam setiap pagi.

paragraphs.text: 朝ごはんを食べて、学校へ行きます。
paragraphs.romanization: Asagohan wo tabete, gakkou e ikimasu.
paragraphs.translation: I eat breakfast and go to school.
paragraphs.translation_en: I eat breakfast and go to school.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya makan sarapan lalu pergi ke sekolah.

paragraphs.text: 夜は日本語を勉強します。
paragraphs.romanization: Yoru wa nihongo wo benkyou shimasu.
paragraphs.translation: In the evening I study Japanese.
paragraphs.translation_en: In the evening I study Japanese.
paragraphs.translation_id: Di malam hari saya belajar bahasa Jepang.

summary_en: A student describes an ordinary day.

title: わたしの家族 — My Family

paragraphs.text: 私の家族は四人です。
paragraphs.romanization: Watashi no kazoku wa yonin desu.
paragraphs.translation: My family has four people.
paragraphs.translation_en: My family has four people.

paragraphs.text: 父は会社員です。母は料理が上手です。
paragraphs.romanization: Chichi wa kaishain desu. Haha wa ryouri ga jouzu desu.
paragraphs.translation: My father is a company employee. My mother is good at cooking.
paragraphs.translation_en: My father is a company employee. My mother is good at cooking.
paragraphs.translation_id: Ayah saya karyawan perusahaan. Ibu saya pandai memasak.

paragraphs.text: 私には妹が一人います。
paragraphs.romanization: Watashi ni wa imouto ga hitori imasu.
paragraphs.translation: I have one younger sister.
paragraphs.translation_en: I have one younger sister.

paragraphs.text: 私はスーパーで果物を買います。
paragraphs.romanization: Watashi wa suupaa de kudamono wo kaimasu.
paragraphs.translation: I buy fruit at the supermarket.
paragraphs.translation_en: I buy fruit at the supermarket.

paragraphs.text: りんごとバナナを買いました。
paragraphs.romanization: Ringo to banana wo kaimashita.
paragraphs.translation: I bought apples and bananas.
paragraphs.translation_en: I bought apples and bananas.

paragraphs.text: いくらですか。と店員さんに聞きました。
paragraphs.romanization: Ikura desu ka. To ten'in-san ni kikimashita.
paragraphs.translation: I asked the shop assistant how much it costs.
paragraphs.translation_en: I asked the shop assistant how much it costs.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya bertanya kepada penjual berapa harganya.

title: 天気 — Weather
summary: A short talk about today's weather.

paragraphs.text: 今日はいい天気です。
paragraphs.romanization: Kyou wa ii tenki desu.
paragraphs.translation: The weather is nice today.
paragraphs.translation_en: The weather is nice today.

paragraphs.text: 空が青くて、暖かいです。
paragraphs.romanization: Sora ga aokute, atatakai desu.
paragraphs.translation: The sky is blue and it is warm.
paragraphs.translation_en: The sky is blue and it is warm.

paragraphs.text: 明日は雨かもしれません。
paragraphs.romanization: Ashita wa ame kamoshiremasen.
paragraphs.translation: It might rain tomorrow.
paragraphs.translation_en: It might rain tomorrow.

summary_en: A short talk about today's weather.
summary_id: Percakapan singkat tentang cuaca hari ini.

paragraphs.text: 私の町は小さいです。
paragraphs.romanization: Watashi no machi wa chiisai desu.
paragraphs.translation: My town is small.
paragraphs.translation_en: My town is small.

paragraphs.text: 駅と本屋とパン屋があります。
paragraphs.romanization: Eki to hon'ya to pan-ya ga arimasu.
paragraphs.translation: There is a station, a bookstore, and a bakery.
paragraphs.translation_en: There is a station, a bookstore, and a bakery.
paragraphs.translation_id: Ada stasiun, toko buku, dan toko roti.

paragraphs.text: 静かで、住みやすいです。
paragraphs.romanization: Shizuka de, sumiyasui desu.
paragraphs.translation: It is quiet and easy to live in.
paragraphs.translation_en: It is quiet and easy to live in.

paragraphs.text: 私のしゅみは写真を撮ることです。
paragraphs.romanization: Watashi no shumi wa shashin wo toru koto desu.
paragraphs.translation: My hobby is taking photos.
paragraphs.translation_en: My hobby is taking photos.

paragraphs.text: 休みの日に山へ行きます。
paragraphs.romanization: Yasumi no hi ni yama e ikimasu.
paragraphs.translation: On days off I go to the mountains.
paragraphs.translation_en: On days off I go to the mountains.
paragraphs.translation_id: Di hari libur saya pergi ke pegunungan.

paragraphs.text: きれいな写真が撮れます。
paragraphs.romanization: Kirei na shashin ga toremasu.
paragraphs.translation: I can take beautiful photos.
paragraphs.translation_en: I can take beautiful photos.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya bisa mengambil foto yang indah.

paragraphs.text: 私は寿司が大好きです。
paragraphs.romanization: Watashi wa sushi ga daisuki desu.
paragraphs.translation: I love sushi.
paragraphs.translation_en: I love sushi.

paragraphs.text: よく寿司屋に行きます。
paragraphs.romanization: Yoku sushi-ya ni ikimasu.
paragraphs.translation: I often go to a sushi restaurant.
paragraphs.translation_en: I often go to a sushi restaurant.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya sering pergi ke restoran sushi.

paragraphs.text: でも、とても高いです。
paragraphs.romanization: Demo, totemo takai desu.
paragraphs.translation: But it is very expensive.
paragraphs.translation_en: But it is very expensive.

paragraphs.text: 私の学校は駅の近くにあります。
paragraphs.romanization: Watashi no gakkou wa eki no chikaku ni arimasu.
paragraphs.translation: My school is near the station.
paragraphs.translation_en: My school is near the station.

paragraphs.text: 学校には図書館があります。
paragraphs.romanization: Gakkou ni wa toshokan ga arimasu.
paragraphs.translation: My school has a library.
paragraphs.translation_en: My school has a library.

paragraphs.text: 私はそこで本を読みます。
paragraphs.romanization: Watashi wa soko de hon wo yomimasu.
paragraphs.translation: I read books there.
paragraphs.translation_en: I read books there.
